specification_purpose: Preregister the rules for a third, separately versioned market-cap universe that is a strictly additional batch of assets below the v2 universe floor. This file is a design artifact: it freezes rules before any v3 data is retrieved or any v3 result exists, and it authorizes nothing.

sections_implemented_here: BRAIN-012 recommendation 1: preregister the new version and its retrieval window first
BRAIN-012 recommendation 2: retrieve exactly one market-cap snapshot inside the pinned window
BRAIN-012 recommendation 3: validate every candidate against real provider data
BRAIN-012 recommendation 5: separate namespaces for every version
BRAIN-012 recommendation 6: inherit the strategy grid, costs, folds and selection rule unchanged
BRAIN-012 recommendation 7: keep an append-only cross-version expansion log
BRAIN-012 recommendation 8: re-check on a bounded cadence and record a null result
BRAIN-012 recommendation 9: route exhaustion to the next version, never to a rewrite
sections_deliberately_not_implemented_he: BRAIN-012 acceptance test 4: the v3 execution path (src/v3_campaign/)
BRAIN-012 acceptance test 9: any authorized v3 run

supersedes.reason: The v2 universe is frozen, its selection run has been performed and its confirmatory window is single-use. The v3 universe is a strictly additional batch of assets below the v2 universe floor, so it supersedes the v2 universe only in the sense that it is the program's current universe version.
supersedes.supersession_scope: Additive only. The v1 and v2 artifacts are not replaced, rewritten or reinterpreted: they remain immutable historical evidence, and the v3 candidate set contains no asset of either of them.

hashing.note: The specification_hash binds every other field of this file, including created_utc. Recomputing it over the parsed document with the key removed is the only accepted verification.

inheritance.statement: v3 changes the evaluated universe only. The strategy family, the 2,304-configuration grid, cost assumptions, execution semantics, fold structure, selection rule, pilot gate, metrics, baselines and status vocabulary are inherited from v1 without modification, and the data retrieval contract is inherited from v2 without modification, so that v3 differs from v2 in which assets are evaluated and not in how a strategy is measured.

universe.survivorship_disclaimer: Current-universe snapshot used; historical point-in-time ranks unavailable. Results have survivorship limitations.

expansion_scope.rule: The v3 universe is the next batch below the recorded floor: assets of a fresh market-cap snapshot whose market capitalization is strictly below the floor and that are not assets of the v1 or v2 universe.

prior_universe_floor.recompute_rule: the floor is the minimum market_cap_usd over the eligible_assets of research/universe_manifest_v2.json; the verifier recomputes it from that manifest and never trusts this recorded value
prior_universe_floor.note: The v3 batch contains only assets that a fresh, deeper ranking places below the market capitalization of the lowest asset that universe version v2 evaluated. The v2 universe itself is not re-ranked, widened or narrowed.

prior_universe_asset_identity.rule: An asset is 'already in a prior universe' when its Binance symbol or its CoinGecko id already occurs in the eligible assets of the v1 or the v2 universe manifest.
prior_universe_asset_identity.rename_rule: A renamed asset keeps its CoinGecko id and is therefore the same asset; it is excluded from the v3 batch as already_in_prior_universe.

expansion_scope.ordering_rule: Candidates are taken in strictly descending market-capitalization order after the prior-universe and exclusion rules have been applied; the batch contains exactly top_n assets unless the snapshot runs out of eligible names, in which case the shortfall is recorded.

snapshot_retrieval.rule: The v3 universe is exactly one timestamped market-cap snapshot retrieved inside the window below. The first successful retrieval inside the window is the v3 snapshot.
snapshot_retrieval.if_window_expires: Record the provider failure evidence with endpoint, HTTP status, probe timestamp and command, and re-preregister a new window in a versioned amendment. Never reuse an expired window silently.
snapshot_retrieval.no_cherry_picking: The window is fixed by this specification. The retrieval must not be delayed, repeated or re-timed to obtain a more convenient ranking, and the snapshot must not be selected after seeing any strategy result.
snapshot_retrieval.raw_response_hash: sha256 over the exact bytes of the provider response, stored beside the v3 universe manifest
snapshot_retrieval.prior_snapshots_are_not_re_retrieved: The v1 snapshot (2026-10-15T17:10:38Z) and the v2 snapshot (2026-10-19T18:47:56Z) are immutable historical evidence and are never re-retrieved or re-timed.

snapshot_identity.note: BRAIN-008 section 1, carried forward. Any artifact that freezes v3 candidates must record this tuple.

binance_spot_verification.rule: The trading pair <SYMBOL>USDT must exist on Binance spot and be tradeable at snapshot time.
binance_spot_verification.failover_policy: One bounded request to the primary host. If it fails (for example HTTP 451), use the documented failover host and record both statuses with timestamps. Do not blindly retry the primary host.

candle_history.rule: A constituent with fewer than 26,280 validated closed hourly candles is excluded and recorded with an exclusion_reason. Missing history is never interpolated, back-filled or shortened.

data_integrity.provenance: real provider candles only; synthetic fallback is forbidden in any campaign-path artifact
data_integrity.survivorship_and_adjustment_policy: v1 policy, unchanged, unless a later preregistered version says otherwise

eligibility_validation.exclusion_rules: The exclusion_rules block of the v2 universe manifest, copied unchanged from research/universe_manifest.json, is applied before evaluation. Every excluded candidate records an exclusion_reason.
eligibility_validation.failure_handling: Exclude and record. Never promote, never substitute a different asset, and never lower the history requirement to admit a constituent.

holdout.v1_holdout_note: The 54 exposed v1 holdout records are historical evidence of an already-consumed window. They are never reused as confirmation for v1 or v2 candidates.

v2_confirmatory_window.note: The v2 confirmatory window is single-use evidence for the v2 candidate set and cannot exist before 2027-01-17T22:00:00Z. A v3 expansion never reads it, re-times it, reuses it or extends it (BRAIN-012 D-3), and the v2 holdout exposure counter is not touched by any v3 artifact.

v3_confirmatory_window.rule: A fresh, unexposed confirmatory window evaluated only after the v3 candidate manifest is frozen and hash-bound.
v3_confirmatory_window.min_hours_rationale: 90 days of closed hourly candles; the v1 protocol used a 0.2 holdout fraction of a multi-year window, which is of the same order.
v3_confirmatory_window.access_counting: Every read of a candle inside the v3 confirmatory window increments holdout_exposed_count in the v3 checkpoint and is recorded in the v3 holdout report.
v3_confirmatory_window.not_a_v1_or_v2_holdout: This is a new protocol object, not a re-opening of the v1 final holdout or of the v2 confirmatory window. It is never populated with data that predates the v3 candidate freeze.

holdout.candidate_freeze_rule: The v3 candidate manifest (at most one candidate per asset, selected under the unchanged v1 selection block) must be committed and hash-bound before the first confirmatory-window candle is read.

criteria: net_total_return > 0 at baseline costs (1x) over the confirmatory window
net_total_return > 0 at 2x costs over the confirmatory window
the evaluated parameters are byte-identical to the frozen v2 candidate manifest entry
promotion_rule.status_semantics: PROVISIONAL_HISTORICAL_SURVIVAL means the candidate survived the preregistered historical confirmatory tests; it does not establish future profitability.
promotion_rule.reporting_obligation: Every evaluated asset and candidate is reported, including zero-trade, excluded and failed outcomes. Negative and inconclusive results are never discarded.

comparability.statement: v1 cycle-0 results (497,664 validation-only units, 0 holdout units) and the v2 selection results (497,664 validation-only units, 0 holdout units) are bound to their own universes, grids and data manifests. They are not comparable to v3 results without a bridging analysis, and they are never restated, re-counted or extended by v3.
rules: v3 results must not be appended to, tallied with, or substituted into v1 or v2 shards, ledgers, manifests or tallies
the v3 expansion neither confirms nor rejects any v1 or v2 candidate
the v3 universe is an additional batch below the v2 floor, not a re-ranking of the v2 universe
a bridging analysis is required before any cross-version quantitative comparison is reported

expansion_program.log_entry_rule: Each universe version appends exactly one entry to the log. Every entry carries its own hash and the hash of the previous entry, so the log is append-only and its history is verifiable.
expansion_program.new_name_rule: A v3 candidate is an asset that is not in the v1 or v2 universe (matched on Binance symbol and CoinGecko id) and whose market capitalization is strictly below the recorded prior floor.
expansion_program.floor_rule: The floor of the next version is the market capitalization of the lowest-ranked candidate of this version.

cadence.polling_forbidden: The program must not contact the provider on every agent activation; a pass is scheduled at the bounded cadence instead.
cadence.not_permanently_complete: One pass without new eligible names does not make the program permanently complete; the program re-checks at the bounded cadence.

expansion_program.negative_result_handling: A pass that yields no currently eligible new names is recorded with the observed endpoint, timestamp, ranking depth and the validation/exclusion results, and the program enters AWAITING_NEW_CANDIDATES.
expansion_program.routing: Completion or exhaustion of one frozen version routes to the preregistration of the next version, never to a rewrite of the finished snapshot.

prerequisites.requirement: A preregistered v3 specification (universe, expansion scope, data requirements, holdout) recorded in an immutable hashed spec
prerequisites.evidence: specification_hash over the canonical content of this file, verified by scripts/verify_research_v3_spec.py and tests/test_research_v3_spec.py

prerequisites.requirement: A v3 universe manifest built from one snapshot inside the pinned window, with every new constituent validated per the eligibility rules above
A v3 data manifest and candle verification artifacts
A v3 candidate freeze that is hash-bound before any selection or confirmatory read
A v3 execution protocol and an explicit bounded run authorization for at most one logical run
prerequisites.artifact: configs/research_v3_execution.json and the v3 selection authorization

prerequisites.requirement: A preregistered v3 confirmatory-window protocol, its runbook and its authorization, written before the window exists
prerequisites.artifact: the v3 confirmatory protocol and its amendments

authorization.scope: This specification freezes rules. It does not authorize a v3 snapshot retrieval, a v3 data fetch, a v3 manifest, a v3 campaign, a v3 grid run, a v3 selection or any confirmatory-window evaluation.
not_authorized_by_this_specification_alo: retrieving the v3 market-cap snapshot outside the preregistered retrieval window
fetching candles for any v3 constituent
running any campaign, grid or backtest under v3
reading any candle inside a v2 or v3 confirmatory window
modifying configs/research_v1.json, configs/research_v2.json, any v1 or v2 manifest, the v1 or v2 shards, the v1 or v2 ledger or the exposed v1 holdout records
authorization.next_session_authorization: A later session may implement P2 and P3 only: take the market-cap snapshot inside the pinned retrieval window, validate every candidate per the eligibility rules above, and write research/universe_manifest_v3.json and research/data_manifest_v3.json with the raw provider response and its hash. That session must not run a v3 campaign, a v3 grid, a v3 selection or any confirmatory-window evaluation, and it must not touch the v1 or v2 artifacts.
authorization.v1_campaign_authorization: Unchanged. research_state/campaign_authorization.json remains bound to protocol v1 and the v1 specification hash. This specification does not rotate, extend, re-authorize or revoke it, and it does not change the code hash.
authorization.v2_artifacts_authorization: Unchanged. The v2 specification, the v2 universe and data manifests, the v2 candidate freeze, the v2 selection authorization, the v2 selection ledger and the v2 selected-configurations manifest are immutable and remain the evidence of the completed v2 selection run.
authorization.unblocking_condition: P2, P3 and P4 committed and hash-bound are required before any v3 selection. Each further step requires its own recorded decision and evidence.

data.failover_policy: One bounded request to the primary host. If it fails (for example HTTP 451), use the documented failover host and record both statuses with timestamps. The primary host is failed over, not blindly retried. max_retries applies to transient failures on the active endpoint only.
